test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

Lalita said to Ruma, “I would never have gone on the expedition if you had told me about the risk.”

options.text: Lalita told Ruma that she would have never gone on the expedition if she had told her about the risk.
Lalita was telling Ruma that she would never have gone on the expedition if she had been told about the risk.
Lalita told Ruma that I would never have gone on the expedition if she you had told me about the risk.
Lalita told Ruma that she would have never have gone on the expedition if she had been told her about the risk.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Lalita told Ruma that she would have never gone on the expedition if she had told her about the risk.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There are a few rules to keep in mind when changing a sentence from direct speech to indirect speech.
 
• In the given sentence, the reporting verb "**said to**"(direct) changes to **"told" **in indirect speech.
 
• The first-person pronouns in direct speech such as **I **and **me **will change to third-person pronouns such as** he/she** and **him/her** respectively..
 
• The second person pronoun such as **you **in direct speech will change to **he/she** as per the "object pronoun" of the reporting verb.
 
• In the given sentence, "**I**" will change to "**she".**
 
• In the case of the second-person pronoun **"you" **will also change to **"she "**as it is the object of the sentence.
 
• Also, the first person pronoun **me **will change to **her **in reported speech.
 
• The sentence in the Direct speech is a** third conditional** sentence. Let's look at an example:
 
 
• If I **had** studied, I **would've passed** the exam.
 
 
 
• The tense form in third conditional sentences, when changed from Direct to Indirect, doesn't change.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
